podcast.title: Cover of "Love Is Strange"
podcast.body: The Maddox Brothers and Rose were among the "dozens upon dozens" of performers who covered Mickey & Sylvia's hit song "Love Is Strange." "It's one of those records that everyone knows, and it went on to be covered by dozens upon dozens of performers, including the Maddox Brothers and Vose."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 49: "Love is Strange" by Mickey and Sylvia

podcast.title: Genre Bridging Group
podcast.body: This sibling group is recognized for bridging the gap between western swing and the emerging Bakersfield sound. They were poor migrants who moved to California before the main influx of "Oak Ease." They are often given credit for making the first rock and roll record, though this claim is considered largely meaningless. They were a significant influence on both the Bakersfield sound and the music that became rockabilly. Wanda Jackson admired their stage presence, "shiny costumes," and particularly Rose's feistiness.

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 43: "I Gotta Know" by Wanda Jackson
